inventory_unit_links.implemented: Exact complex 3x2 Gram matrix, full Euclidean squared-norm identity/lower bound, actual two-mode summed correlator, and explicit nonzero invisible vector after the specified row deletion.

mathematical_scope: Energy space is NNReal, exactly representing nonnegative energies and including the vacuum energy zero.
Measures are arbitrary finite positive measures, not finite atomic test models.
Every t is a real physical time >=0; the limiting and countable exhaustion arguments use actual analysis.
The dense-family projection theorems use continuous linear operators on real normed spaces; an underlying real normed structure also covers complex Hilbert-space applications.
The spectral theorem and OS reconstruction are explicit application inputs; no self-adjoint Hamiltonian or physical measure is manufactured from a decay assumption.
No spectral-support conclusion or projection-vanishing conclusion is included among the hypotheses.
